### `Status`

```cpp
Status
```

Result codes returned by expected TUI operations.

[Status::OK](#symbol-namespacepuc_1_1tui_1a54fbc93845e81aad92256b80e55df270ae0aa021e21dddbd6d8cecec71e9cf564) is the sole success value. All other values describe failures a caller can log, propagate, or handle without exceptions.

#### Values
- <a id="symbol-namespacepuc_1_1tui_1a54fbc93845e81aad92256b80e55df270ae0aa021e21dddbd6d8cecec71e9cf564"></a>`OK` — Operation completed successfully.
- <a id="symbol-namespacepuc_1_1tui_1a54fbc93845e81aad92256b80e55df270af295a0c3e37c94f078e1c5476479132d"></a>`INVALID_ARGUMENT` — Required object, id, or value is invalid.
- <a id="symbol-namespacepuc_1_1tui_1a54fbc93845e81aad92256b80e55df270a85d5c1a701eb47300e4687b82001fac9"></a>`INVALID_DIMENSIONS` — Dimensions are zero where positivity is required.
- <a id="symbol-namespacepuc_1_1tui_1a54fbc93845e81aad92256b80e55df270afc045e96b0d4f9791e061ee5eb2e9ed8"></a>`DIMENSION_OVERFLOW` — Dimension arithmetic exceeds addressable storage.
- <a id="symbol-namespacepuc_1_1tui_1a54fbc93845e81aad92256b80e55df270a27023964231ab51c6c6da5851bd668d8"></a>`FRAME_ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS` — A [Canvas](classpuc_1_1tui_1_1_canvas.md) transaction is already active.
- <a id="symbol-namespacepuc_1_1tui_1a54fbc93845e81aad92256b80e55df270a724ef1baa751cd6e245cc246e1868fa2"></a>`NO_FRAME_IN_PROGRESS` — A [Canvas](classpuc_1_1tui_1_1_canvas.md) mutation requires an active transaction.

- <a id="symbol-namespacepuc_1_1tui_1a54fbc93845e81aad92256b80e55df270a495ebbc25234b754e9984ff6cd72249d"></a>`CELL_SHAPE_MISMATCH` — Source cell rows do not match their rectangle.
- <a id="symbol-namespacepuc_1_1tui_1a54fbc93845e81aad92256b80e55df270ad4b3d7863079cc31e48ce56a1e9e4b3e"></a>`DUPLICATE_FRAME_ID` — A [ZBuffer](classpuc_1_1tui_1_1_z_buffer.md) already contains the frame id.

### `status_message`

```cpp
std::string_view puc::tui::status_message(Status status) noexcept
```

Return a stable, human-readable description of a status code.

Unknown enum values map to `"unknown terminal UI status"` so diagnostic paths never need a second failure channel.

**Parameters**

- `status` (in) — [Status](#symbol-namespacepuc_1_1tui_1a54fbc93845e81aad92256b80e55df270) value to describe.

**Returns:** A static string suitable for logs and diagnostics.

[Source](../../puc-cli/tui/status.hpp#L73)
